Order No. 05 Dated 03rd December, 2025 I.A. No. 13158 of 2025 Heard the learned counsel for the respective parties.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.

The appellant has been convicted for the offences u/s 376-AB and 506 of the IPC and Sections 4, 8 and 12 of the POCSO Act and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for 20 years along with a fine of Rs. 20,000/- for the offence u/s 376-AB of the IPC.
It has been alleged that the daughter of the informant was subjected to rape who happens to be the uncle of the victim.

Submission has been advanced by the learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant has been implicated on account of previous enmity which can be deciphered from the evidence of PW-3 and PW-4 who happens to be the parents of the victim.
Learned counsel submits that the appellant is in custody for about 6 years and no sign of rape has been found on the person of the victim.
Learned APP has opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant.
The victim has been examined as PW-1 and she has categorically stated about the appellant subjecting her to rape.
The medical report indicates that old hymen ruptured was found on the person of the victim.
On consideration of the aforesaid facts, we are not inclined to admit the appellant on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the appellant is hereby rejected.
This I.A. stands rejected.
